description:
Explain a change between two periods as a waterfall chart plus a plain-language summary. The chart shows the start total, the 8 biggest movers (the rest become one "Other (n)" bar) and the end total, inside a card with a start / end / change KPI strip.

Use this tool when: the user asks what changed between two periods (revenue October to November, headcount, signups by channel) and you have a before and after value for each item, or the change of each item.
Do NOT use this tool when: you just want a chart of values → use render_chart; you need a reason. The explanation says WHAT changed, never WHY. Do not add causes the data does not show.

Items: give every item as {name, start, end}, OR every item as {name, delta} together with start_total. Do not mix the two. Names must be unique (case-insensitive), 1–100 items. start_total and end_total are optional checks when items use start/end. Numbers that do not add up are a 400 that shows the numbers and the difference; nothing is silently fixed.
explain: true, "template" or "ai" adds a written explanation and uses one waterfall allowance. The Free plan has none, so explain on Free is a 402. The chart alone works on Free. "ai" text is checked against the data; if it is rejected you get the template text and a warning. Template wording is English only.
output: "image" (default) returns the chart inline plus the text; "url" returns text with the image link. PDF is always returned as a link (Pro or Agency).

Returns: text with the explanation, start and end totals, the change, the drivers (largest first), the image link and any warnings; plus the image unless output is "url".
Errors (the message is plain text and keeps the API's details): 400 — invalid spec; every failing field is listed with its path. 401 — API key missing or invalid. 402 — monthly allowance used up; do NOT retry, tell the user (the message has the reset date and an upgrade link). 403 — the plan does not include something you used (pdf, a size above the plan cap, a brand kit over the limit); do NOT retry the same request, tell the user. 404 — unknown brand slug (the message lists the available ones). 429 — rate-limited; wait for Retry-After. Network error — chart-output.com is unreachable or timed out.
Example: render_waterfall({ title: "Revenue: October to November", metric: "revenue", start_label: "October", end_label: "November", number_format: { prefix: "$", maximumFractionDigits: 0 }, items: [{ name: "Paid search", start: 18000, end: 23100 }, { name: "Email", start: 9000, end: 11300 }, { name: "Organic", start: 14000, end: 13100 }] })

brand.description: Slug of a saved brand kit (call list_brand_kits to see them), for example "acme-dark". Applies the kit's palette, fonts and logo. Colors you send yourself (dataset colors, theme) win over the kit. An unknown slug is a 404 that lists the real ones. Preset kits (obsidian, linen, polar, studio, ember, harbor) go in extensions.brandKitId instead.

end_label.description: Label of the second period. Default "End".

end_total.description: Optional check that the items add up to this.

explain.description: Add a written explanation. Uses one waterfall allowance (none on Free: that is a 402).

format.description: Image format. Default png. pdf needs Pro or Agency and is returned as a link.

items.description: 1–100 items. Either all {name, start, end} or all {name, delta} (then start_total is required). Names unique, up to 60 characters.

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag. Template wording is English only.

metric.description: What is measured, e.g. "revenue". Used in the explanation sentence.

number_format.description: How numbers are written, e.g. {prefix: "$", maximumFractionDigits: 0}.

output.description: "image" (default) returns the chart inline. "url" returns only text and the link.

scale.description: Pixel density 1–4 (sent as devicePixelRatio). If you leave it out the API uses 2 where your plan allows, else 1.

start_label.description: Label of the first period. Default "Start".

start_total.description: Required when items use delta. Optional check when items use start/end.

textScale.description: Makes all text on a card bigger (header, legend, ticks, KPIs, footer), 1–2. Use for small charts or low vision.

width.description: Width in pixels, 320–4000. Default 800. The longest edge × scale must fit your plan: 1200 px on Free, 3000 px on Pro and Agency (the API answers 403 above that).

name: render_waterfall
